#                            executed (env-gated or all-`#[ignore]`d).
#                            integration suites against both layouts"). Pair each
#                            live Docker Postgres; also compile-checked on every
#                            re-running the suite against the opt-in partitioned
#                            since allos has no Postgres).
#                            such row with its plain `linux` row -- the point is
#                            that the SAME suite passes both ways.
#                            the blanket core `--no-run` step in ci.yml).

#     <(grep    -E '^[[:space:]]*#' .github/ci/integration-suites.txt) \
#     <(grep -vE '^[[:space:]]*(#|$)' .github/ci/integration-suites.txt | LC_ALL=C sort -u)
#   LC_ALL=C sort -o .github/ci/integration-suites.txt \
#   crate    = autumn-harvest | autumn-harvest-plugin | autumn-harvest-redis
#   features = comma-list passed as `--features <v>`, or `-`.
#   filter   = positional filter after `--`, or `-` for the whole target. A
#   osclass   crate                    target       features            filter
#   osclass  = linuxpart   -> exactly `linux`, but with HARVEST_TEST_PARTITIONED=1,
#   target   = the `--test <target>` binary (core suites use `integration`).
# (or simply keep the header on top and `LC_ALL=C sort -u` the data lines).
# Adding a suite = add ONE sorted line here. No `ci.yml` edit, no ALLOWLIST
# CI integration-suite manifest — the single source of truth for which
# Columns (whitespace-separated; `-` = none/absent):
# `--test-threads=1` and `--no-run` are DERIVED from `osclass` by the runner and
# `.github/ci/run-suites.sh` (which the `test` job invokes) and cross-checked
# `manifest_is_sorted_and_unique`, fixed with:
# are never written here — this is what keeps the `--test-threads=1`-after-`--`
# by `autumn-harvest/tests/integration/ci_run_coverage.rs`.
# edit for a wired suite. This file is `merge=union` (see `.gitattributes`), so
# ordering correct by construction.

# per-suite `cargo test` runs CI executes. One suite per line. Read by
